latestVersion.changelog:
Doorstep Video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export door or front-door footage as polished 1080p MP4s, with no manual timeline editing required.
- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and use natural language prompts like "trim the clip, add a title card and export as a shareable video."
- Automatic token management: uses NEMO_TOKEN from environment or requests a free 7-day token as needed. Sessions are established with the backend before processing.
- Cloud GPU rendering pipeline processes jobs in 30–90 seconds; tracks session and job status automatically.
- Supports file uploads, balance checks, state queries, and exports via plain chat commands.
- Handles common errors (token expiration, file limits, credit issues) and keeps user-facing messages simple and clear.
